title: Google Widens Gemini 4 Carbon Access After AI Agents Verify Signal Code
description: Google has expanded access to its Gemini 4 Carbon AI model, which was used by DeepMind to formally verify the security guarantees of the Signal protocol's reference implementation (libsignal). This verification includes guarantees such as forward secrecy, post-compromise security, and authentication at the compiled machine code level. The AI-driven formal verification process significantly reduced the time required for proof generation and helped reclassify and patch critical bugs in open source projects. The verification excludes side channels and applies to Google's build of the code, not Signal's own applications. This advancement suggests AI can make formal verification more practical for real-world security-critical software.
